test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.

Two of the world's / best forwards / has played alongside / David Beckham.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The segment "has played alongside" contains a grammatical error. The subject "Two of the world's best forwards" is plural, so the correct verb form should be "have played" instead of "has played."

Therefore, the corrected sentence should be "Two of the world's best forwards have played alongside David Beckham."

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Two of the world's best forwards have played alongside David Beckham."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1: "Two of the world's"** – This segment is grammatically correct.
 
• **Option 2: "David Beckham."** – This segment is grammatically correct.
 
• **Option 3: "best forwards"** – This segment is grammatically correct.
